# Electra

> Electra operates a fast-charging network of 400+ ultra-fast EV charging stations across Europe with a simple app-based experience and transparent per-kWh pricing.

Electra provides comprehensive electric vehicle charging infrastructure across major European cities including Paris, Lyon, and Marseille, serving both individual drivers and businesses. The platform combines innovative features like Autocharge automatic charging with flexible subscription plans and partnerships with landowners to expand the network.
